opportunities.name: Movie night invite: look up film ratings and draft email
opportunities.description: For a given movie and friend, look up the movie on IMDb (rating, director, runtime) and its Tomatometer on Rotten Tomatoes, then write an email inviting the friend to movie night on a given day.
opportunities.site: imdb.com, rottentomatoes.com, local mail compose page
steps: Open imdb.com, search for {movie} and open the matching title
Note the IMDb rating, director and runtime
Open rottentomatoes.com, search for {movie} and note the Tomatometer score
Open the New message compose page
Type {friend_email} in To
Type 'Movie night {day}: {movie}' in Subject
Type 'Hi {friend}, {day} we watch {movie} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {rating}, Tomatometer {score}%.' in Body
Click Send (the recording shows the user clicking Discard)

instances.values: movie=The Grand Budapest Hotel (IMDb and RT lookups seen; no email before the recording ends)

opportunities.name: npm package stats to notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, collect its version, weekly downloads and license from npmjs.com, plus stars, open issues and latest release date from its GitHub repo, and save them as a note.
steps: Open npmjs.com and search for {package}
Open the exact-match package page
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the Repository link to open the GitHub repo
Note the stars, open issues and latest release date
Open the Notes page and add '{package}: v{version}, {downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {issues} open issues, last release {date}'

instances.values: package=lodash (first typed as 'lodahs'; v4.18.1, 131,289,453/week, MIT, 61.4k stars)
package=express (search results only; no note before the recording ends)

opportunities.name: Recipe and dish origin to notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish, find the top-rated recipe on Allrecipes (rating, time, key ingredients), look up the dish's place of origin on Wikipedia, and save a note.
steps: Open allrecipes.com and search for {dish}
Open the top recipe result and dismiss any popup
Note the recipe name, rating, total time, servings and key ingredients
Open wikipedia.org and search for {dish}
Read the 'Place of origin' field in the infobox
Open the Notes page and add '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}'

instances.values: dish=shakshuka (Chef John's Shakshuka, 4.8 stars, 50 mins; origin Ottoman North Africa)
dish=pad thai (searched 'lemon tart' first and dropped it; origin Thailand)
